boundaryCondition.open: energy may leave the solved room through this patch; exterior space is not solved and no return reflection is generated
boundaryCondition.absorptive: frequency-dependent energy loss over a bounded surface patch
boundaryCondition.scattering: frequency-dependent redistribution of reflected energy over a bounded surface patch
boundaryCondition.impedance: general frequency-dependent boundary impedance where supported by the selected solver strategy

rules: boundary conditions may vary by surface patch
an open boundary patch remains part of the room boundary topology but is non-reflecting for the solved interior domain
attached AcousticObject instances may bind their acoustic behavior to bounded patches of room surfaces
render primitive geometry and acoustic boundary semantics remain separate
